tasks_completed.description: Added sessionSidechainEventSchema to wire protocol with t='sidechain' and prompt field; added to discriminated union
tasks_completed.changes: Added z.object({ t: z.literal('sidechain'), prompt: z.string() }) schema and included it in sessionEventSchema discriminated union
tasks_completed.rationale: Wire protocol lacked a sidechain event type, preventing typed sidechain envelope flow

tasks_completed.description: Changed CLI mapper sidechain root emission from text to sidechain event
tasks_completed.changes: Line 683: changed { t: 'text', text } to { t: 'sidechain', prompt: text } for isSidechain messages
tasks_completed.rationale: CLI was sending sidechain roots as plain text events, preventing the App from identifying them as sidechain roots

tasks_completed.description: Extended CLI launcher to create synthetic sidechain root for Agent tool (not just Task)
tasks_completed.rationale: Agent tool was excluded from synthetic sidechain root creation, so Agent tool cards had no sidechain conversation

tasks_completed.description: Added sidechain event handler to App normalizer
tasks_completed.changes: Added handler for envelope.ev.t === 'sidechain' producing NormalizedMessage with content type 'sidechain', isSidechain: true, and prompt field
tasks_completed.rationale: App normalizer had no handler for sidechain events, so they were silently dropped (returned null)

tasks_completed.description: Added CUID2 registration in App tracer for child inheritance
tasks_completed.changes: After prompt registration block (line 209-210): register input.sessionSubagent CUID2 in state.uuidToSidechainId map
tasks_completed.rationale: Without CUID2 registration, child messages with parentUUID=CUID2 could not inherit sidechainId from their parent tool call

git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Original implementation focused on Task tool only; sidechain flow was not wired end-to-end across all 5 layers (wire, CLI mapper, CLI launcher, App normalizer, App tracer)
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Added sidechain event type to wire protocol, updated CLI to emit it and create synthetic roots for Agent tool, updated App to normalize and trace sidechain events
